def mod_pow(base, exp, modulus):
    result = 1
    while exp > 0:
        if exp & 1:
            result = (result * base) % modulus
        base = (base * base) % modulus
        exp >>= 1
    return result

import sys

MOD = 1000000007

for line in sys.stdin:
    if not line.strip():
        continue
    p_str, k_str = line.strip().split()
    p, k = int(p_str), int(k_str)
    if k == 0:
        print(mod_pow(p, p - 1, MOD))
        continue
    if k == 1:
        print(mod_pow(p, p, MOD))
        continue
    sum_ = 0
    tmp = 1
    next_ = -1
    while True:
        next_ = (k * tmp) % p
        tmp = next_
        sum_ += 1
        if next_ == 1:
            break
    print(mod_pow(p, (p - 1) // sum_, MOD))
